summary: The wildcard generic client path now requires an HTTPS origin or a local-network host, and the new test covers rejection of public HTTP wildcard origins, acceptance of HTTPS wildcard clients, and rejection of public HTTP redirect URIs.

evidence: src/auth_config.ts lines 238-244 reject wildcard generic clients unless the parsed origin is https: or a local-network hostname.
src/config_test.ts lines 438-467 asserts public HTTP wildcard origins resolve to null, HTTPS wildcard clients resolve, and public HTTP redirect URIs are rejected.
Existing tests in src/config_test.ts for generic loopback and local-network clients continue to cover local HTTP development usage.
